entities.summary: Gräsö is an island in Östhammar Municipality, off the coast of Uppland province on the eastern coast of Sweden. It is also the name of a village on the island which lies at the southern end of the Gulf of Bothnia. The island has an area of 93.26 square kilometres (36.01 sq mi) and a population of about 600. The island has a mixture of fields and woodland. It is a popular summer resort. Gräsö is a island in Northern Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
